video_product_target.target_product_name: Momcozy Pregnancy Belly Band YB001, CozySupport Ergonest Maternity Belly Band

baseline_eligibility.policy: Only exact target anchors (high confidence, anchor product_id == target) are baseline and performance eligible. All medium rows are category reference: they may be counted, described, and listed, but they never enter the target baseline, never enter performance statistics, and never support a 'which content form wins' conclusion. Consideration-tagged rows are excluded from all performance statistics. Non-target subline text rows are demoted to low. Low confidence is unconfirmed and excluded from all baseline statistics.

notes: All 141 videos are judged; 64 have no target/category signal and are kept as confidence=none negative rows for audit.
19 medium rows are duplicate-listing anchors; their medium basis is the anchor product title (same Momcozy YB001 series, similar but not identical title, different product_id), not the video caption.
11 medium text rows remain category reference. One additional text row is tagged consideration and also excluded from performance statistics.
7 text rows naming another product line (Go As You Grow, postpartum belly band, nursing-bra mix, Momcozy UK) are demoted to low and tagged non_target_subline.
Only the 10 high-confidence exact-ID rows are baseline and performance eligible; medium rows are category reference only.
Low confidence rows are additionally written to video-product-unconfirmed.jsonl.
High confidence rows are additionally written to video-product-target-baseline.jsonl.

comment_video.judgment: comment -> video relation does not exist in the current corpus; 0% of product reviews can be tied to a video_id
comment_video.reason: The 175 canonical tiktok_shop records are product reviews fetched from /api/v1/tiktok/shop/web/fetch_product_reviews_v2. Their external_id is the review_id (it matches raw review_id 175/175), not a video/aweme id. Neither the canonical source_meta nor the 180 raw review rows expose video_id/aweme_id/item_id. The reviewer_id in the raw payload is the review author's user id, not a video author id. Therefore a comment->video relation cannot be built from this corpus. This is a product-review layer, not a video-comment layer.

product_review_context.note: The task brief said 1133 reviews; the collected raw snapshot says 1137. This report uses the raw snapshot value and does not overwrite the task brief.

baseline_reproduction.note: Cross-check only: the relation table reproduces the existing baseline.json cohorts from the same detail snapshots. It does not recompute or replace baseline.json.

caveats: Keyword search is a non-probability sample; the 141 videos are 12 queries x one page, not a census of the category.

Medium text evidence means brand + belly-band category, not target product specificity. It is category reference only. Text rows that name another product line (Go As You Grow, postpartum band, nursing-bra mix, Momcozy UK) are demoted to low.

Duplicate-listing anchors point to other listings in the same Momcozy YB001 series with different product_ids and similar but not identical titles; they are not merged and are kept in the category-reference bucket.
Search statistics and detail statistics were captured at different times; the detail snapshot is preferred when present.
Interaction rate uses the provider's play/like/comment/share/collect fields; it is not view-through, completion, GMV, or conversion.
The product-review layer and the video layer have different populations; the 175 product reviews cannot be joined to video_id.
what_is_missing_to_close_the_loop: A product->video enumeration endpoint that works without the logged-in creator cookie, or TIKHUB_TIKTOK_CREATOR_COOKIE so get_product_related_videos / get_video_associated_product_list can run.
A review->video key. The current TikTok Shop product-review endpoint does not return video_id/aweme_id/item_id; reviewer_id is not a video or creator id.
Working search pagination. cursor=20 returned the same page, so the 141 videos are 12 keyword queries x 1 page, not a census.
Detail snapshots for all sample videos. 59/141 have fetch_post_detail; 82 rely on search-level stats and anchors.
Profiles for the 72 search-only creators. 52/124 creators have a fetched profile; follower_count for the rest is the search author field.
A product-id merge map for the duplicate Momcozy YB001 / CozySupport Ergonest listings. 19 videos anchor to a duplicate product_id and are kept medium, not high.
Any source for third-party video GMV/orders, audience demographics, or subtitles. TikHub exposes those only for the logged-in creator or not at all.
